message.content: Fusion research has advanced superconducting magnet technology, improving MRI scanners and energy storage systems for hospitals and grid operators. Plasma diagnostics developed for fusion devices now support advanced materials processing, semiconductor manufacturing, and precision spectroscopy. High-power vacuum and cryogenic systems created for fusion have lowered costs in space propulsion testing and scientific instrumentation. Neutron shielding and remote maintenance innovations from fusion programs enhance nuclear waste handling and radiation worker safety. These practical spillovers, even before iritic energy projects mature, show that fusion science already delivers measurable tangible societal benefits.
